title: mandate.v1
description: Work order from a customer agent to a contractor agent: one story out of the customer's tracker, carrying no money and no hours. Application layer inside the transport envelope's `data` field; the envelope's schema tag is `mandate.v1`; the reply arrives in the mandate's `thread_id`.

mandate_id.description: identifier of the mandate at the customer (uuid7)

story_ref.description: identifier of the story in the customer's tracker

acceptance.description: acceptance criteria, verbatim from the card

frame.description: context in words: project, epic, target branch, staging
